captions.linkedin:
Can Claude turn a talking video into a motion-graphics explainer?

I recorded the workflow in Urdu/Hindi, from planning the visuals to checking the exported video. The full tutorial is 4 minutes, including playback of the finished example.

Here is what it covers:
• Use ChatGPT to plan the visual direction.
• Give Claude an editing workflow, source footage and captions.
• Submit clear instructions for the edit.
• Preview the result, export it and check the file.

For teams making product explainers or educational content, the useful part is seeing how the brief becomes an actual video. The export still needs a review: readable text, accurate captions, sensible pacing and a clean ending.

The original creator's private editing skill was unavailable, so I built an equivalent workflow and recorded the steps. The presenter is my AI avatar with my cloned voice; the screen recordings show the actual process.

Which part of your video workflow takes the most time: planning, editing or reviewing?
